questions.q: In which year did the Joker first appear in comics?
questions.why: The Joker debuted in Batman #1, which hit stands in spring 1940.

questions.q: Which artist, alongside Bill Finger and Bob Kane, is credited as a co-creator of the Joker?
questions.why: Jerry Robinson produced the playing-card sketch tied to the Joker, though Kane disputed how much he contributed.

questions.q: Which 1928 silent film's grinning lead inspired the Joker's permanent smile?
questions.why: Bill Finger passed around a photo of Conrad Veidt from The Man Who Laughs, whose grin shaped the Joker's look.

questions.q: In The Killing Joke, what alias does the future Joker wear when he falls into a chemical vat?
questions.why: The 1988 graphic novel by Moore and Bolland shows a failed comedian disguised as the Red Hood during a heist that goes wrong.

questions.q: Which member of the Bat-family does the Joker shoot and paralyze in The Killing Joke?
questions.why: He cripples Barbara Gordon, then tortures her father, trying to prove one bad day can break anyone.

questions.q: Who played the Joker in Tim Burton's 1989 Batman film?
questions.why: Jack Nicholson played the character, named Jack Napier, in the 1989 film.

questions.q: Which actor played the Joker in the 1966 Batman TV series?
questions.why: Cesar Romero was the Clown Prince of Crime in the 1960s series and its film.

questions.q: Which voice actor first voiced the Joker in Batman: The Animated Series in 1992?
questions.why: Mark Hamill started voicing the Joker with the 1992 series and became a definitive version of the role.

questions.q: In which 2016 film did Jared Leto first play the Joker?
options: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice
questions.why: Leto debuted as the Joker in the DC Extended Universe film Suicide Squad in 2016.

questions.q: Which editor overruled Bill Finger's wish to kill off the Joker after his first story?
questions.why: Finger wanted the villain to die in his debut, but editor Whitney Ellsworth kept him alive for future stories.
